Game Overview

Pirates and Cannons is a adventure title where embark on a thrilling pirate adventure, unleashing torpedoes, triple bombs, and sky dynamite to sink rival fleets. Hunt for hidden treasures, earn rewards, and upgrade your arsenal with exciting new items. Defend your honor and become the ultimate pirate commander!

Pirates and Cannons keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge.
